# Municipal Ordinance No. 12, Series of 1997

**Tax Amnesty for Delinquent Realty Taxpayers**

## Summary

This municipal ordinance grants a tax amnesty to all delinquent realty taxpayers in Pitogo, Quezon. It provides a 50% discount on realty taxes, including surcharges and penalties, up to [[1995]]. The amnesty is valid until December 31, [[1997]], and the amnesty period is six months after approval.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** All delinquent taxpayers shall be granted a 50% discount on all realty taxes including surcharges and penalties up to [[1995]].
2.  **Section 2.** Amnesty shall be granted provided that taxes shall be paid up to December 31, [[1997]].
3.  **Section 3.** Amnesty period is six (6) months after approval.
4.  **Section 4.** Every real estate property with unpaid taxes of ₱ 10,000.00 or more shall be sold at public auction in accordance with law.
5.  **Section 5.** Repealing Clause - Any ordinance inconsistent herewith is hereby repealed accordingly.
6.  **Section 6.** This ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after its approval.
